artifacts.name: Web/CMS Handoff Bundle — cover / system overview
artifacts.summary: Deck index page: names the bundle's 8 pages as files (tokens.css, tokens.json, fonts.txt, cms-schema.md x3, go-live-checklist.md), states the system in one paragraph (Notion owns content; forms tool owns RSVPs and consent; display layer is a mirror; nightly sync; RSVP saves the seat only, letter joins via explicit opt-in), and the build paths. This page is the naming source for artifacts 2-8 below.

artifacts.name: tokens.css
artifacts.summary: The v1.1 :root variable set as copyable CSS text. Values agree with design-tokens-v1.1.json everywhere both carry them (Nov 1 errata). Exclusions: its contrast comments and the loosened camel comment are NOT transcribed (errata P1-P7, D7); the record governs.

artifacts.name: tokens.json
artifacts.summary: The v1.1 W3C token set as copyable JSON text. Programmatic diff vs design-tokens-v1.1.json: 91 leaf values (7 colors, 4 radii, 5 spacing, 2 touch, 3 motion, 9 type styles), 0 differences (errata method, re-run by the design-kit skill's parser smoke test 2026-11-02).

artifacts.name: fonts.txt
artifacts.summary: Five-family stack with links and roles: Fredoka (display), Blinker (labels), Montserrat (body), EB Garamond (accents, italic only), IBM Plex Mono (configuration voice). Fonts travel via this page / the CSS slide as REPORTED input; the v1.1 JSON does not enumerate the stack.

artifacts.name: cms-schema.md — content
artifacts.summary: Content schema, field by field: Notion property -> display field, types and rules. gatherings is the public face of CONTENT; the sync reads only the 'next up' view (published + start >= today, ascending); 'the vault' holds the past; status=cancelled keeps the page live with a plain banner. Conventions: lowercase_snake_case, ISO 8601 with times, blanks stay blank, partial data never publishes. Field lists below are transcribed from the slide text in this pass (not a CLI reconstruction). Transport named in the deck (Framer/Make) is superseded; field contracts carry over per spec §5.3.

artifacts.name: cms-schema.md — people
artifacts.summary: People schema: the per-event RSVP form fields and the consent ledger columns, plus the consent contract (RSVP saves the seat only; the letter joins exclusively via the checkbox, tracked with source and timestamp, spoken aloud on the confirmation screen) and six RSVP-fired automations (guest confirmation, host heads-up digest, ledger row, letter handoff, 48h reminder, cancellation note). Form rules: closes itself at the deadline, capacity flips replies to a waitlist tag, duplicate email updates the seat, letter_opt_in is never pre-ticked.

artifacts.name: cms-schema.md — sync
artifacts.summary: Sync scenario, module by module: (1) watch the 'next up' view, (2) completeness check (missing start/end/timezone = skipped and logged; partial data never publishes), (3) map fields per page 05 with the Notion page id as external key, (4) upsert (match updates, no match creates, gone archives), (5) on error degrade to warmth (last good publish stays live, host gets a plain email, scenario pauses). Content syncs nightly; RSVPs are real time and never lost on failure. The deck's Make/Framer transport does not carry over; the step contract and failure behavior map onto the CMS connector contract (spec §5.3).

artifacts.name: go-live-checklist.md
artifacts.summary: Eight setup moves in order (duplicate the Notion template; fill three real gatherings, complete rows only; load tokens.css + fonts; create the gatherings collection with the page-05 names/types; clone the RSVP form per event and paste each URL into rsvp_url; import the sync scenario and run once by hand; RSVP to your own event and watch the ledger/confirmation/consent line; flip status to published), the weekly five-minute check, and the failure table. Setup specifics name the deck's retired transport; the sequence and the completeness discipline carry over.
